title: Hypertension with heart failure
quote: Hypertension with heart conditions classified to I50.-, Heart failure, I51.4, Myocarditis, unspecified, I51.89, Other ill-defined heart diseases, and I51.9, Heart disease, unspecified, is assigned to a code from category I11, Hypertensive heart disease.
provenance: premises and conclusions structured from the quoted guideline text, 2026-09-25

title: Hypertensive heart disease: add the heart failure code
quote: Use additional code(s) from category I50, Heart failure, or I51, Complications and ill-defined descriptions of heart disease, to identify the heart condition.
provenance: premises and conclusions structured from the quoted guideline text, 2026-09-25

title: Hypertension with chronic kidney disease
quote: Assign codes from category I12, Hypertensive chronic kidney disease, when both hypertension and a condition classifiable to category N18, Chronic kidney disease (CKD), are present.
provenance: premises and conclusions structured from the quoted guideline text, 2026-09-25

title: Hypertensive CKD: add the CKD stage code
quote: The appropriate code from category N18 should be used as a secondary code with a code from category I12 to identify the stage of chronic kidney disease.
provenance: premises and conclusions structured from the quoted guideline text, 2026-09-25

title: Hypertension with heart disease and chronic kidney disease
quote: Assign codes from combination category I13, Hypertensive heart and chronic kidney disease, when there is hypertension with both heart and chronic kidney disease.
provenance: premises and conclusions structured from the quoted guideline text, 2026-09-25

title: Atherosclerotic heart disease with angina
quote: ICD-10-CM has combination codes for atherosclerotic heart disease with angina pectoris. The subcategories for these codes are I25.11, Atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary artery with angina pectoris and I25.7, Atherosclerosis of coronary artery bypass graft(s) and coronary artery of transplanted heart with angina pectoris.
provenance: premises and conclusions structured from the quoted guideline text, 2026-09-25

title: BMI only with an associated reportable diagnosis
quote: BMI codes should only be assigned when there is an associated, reportable diagnosis (such as obesity or anorexia) documented by the patient’s provider.
